dirichlet_definition: Mean over test graphs of the mean directed-edge squared distance between row-wise L2-normalized hidden vectors.

oracle_ceiling.image_processing: OpenCV BGR images and grayscale masks resized to 256x256; mask binarized >128.
oracle_ceiling.label_rule: Superpixel positive iff mean of resized binary GT pixels strictly exceeds 0.30.
oracle_ceiling.scoring: Pixel-level binary F1 on flattened GT and reconstructed mask, then mean and population SD across images.
oracle_ceiling.caveat: Fixed 0.30 occupancy labeling is not an optimized oracle for pixel F1; old reference model scores are hardcoded.
